picks: Hotel de Rome — De Rome Spa
Best sauna you can't easily book
practical: For a normal sauna session rather than a luxury spa day, **KIEZ SAUNA, Saunabad, Olivin and Lützow** are better benchmarks than most hotel spas. Hotel spas make more sense when the pool, terrace, relaxation area, or USC access is part of what you want.
